sentences.text:
Shiv Kumar Agarwal & Anr vs Unknown on 2 March, 2026
02.03.2026
Item No.15
Ct. No. 34
 nb
 Crr 795 of 2026

In the matter of: Shiv Kumar Agarwal & Anr.
 ...... petitioner.
 Mr. Krishnendu Bhattacharya,
 Mr. Rajib Mullick,
 Mr. Subham Chatterjee,
 Ms. Sonia Mukherjee,
 ....For the Petitioners.

2. The matter pertains for quashing of criminal proceeding in connection with complaint lodged by the opposite party no.2 under Section 498A/406/34 of the IPC read with Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
3. The present petitioners are the parents-in-law.
The marriage was held in the year 2012 and they have been falsely framed.
4. Prima facie, it is seen that the written complaint is absolutely silent about any role attributed by the present petitioner.
An arguable case has been made out regarding the point of maintainability of the complaint against the present petitioner.

5. The petitioners are directed to serve copy of this revisional application to the opposite party no.1/State in the office of the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court at Calcutta as well as opposite party no.2 by Speed Post and file affidavit of service on the next date of hearing.

6. Let the matter be listed four weeks hence under the heading "Contested Application".
7.
In the meantime, there shall be an order of stay of all further proceeding pending before the learned Court till April 30, 2026 or until further order, whichever is earlier.
